plugin/agent-metrics.title: Agent metrics
plugin/agent-metrics.summary: Records tokens, API-equivalent cost and latency for every project, task and subagent through the agent-meter CLI.
plugin/agent-metrics.use: You want to know what each task costs and why an agent is slow.

plugin/docs-and-quality.title: Docs and quality
plugin/docs-and-quality.summary: Documentation standards, test-driven development and the Karpathy coding guidelines, plus a gate that rejects lazy stubs left in the diff.
plugin/docs-and-quality.use: You want clean docs and no TODO placeholders in finished code.

plugin/git-workflow.title: Git workflow
plugin/git-workflow.summary: Blocks commits on main and develop, checks Conventional Commit messages and stops the session if a merge is left half done.
plugin/git-workflow.use: You want safe branches and consistent commit history.

plugin/multi-agent-ops.title: Multi-agent ops
plugin/multi-agent-ops.summary: Loop engineering for agents that correct themselves, codebase research, and a guard that keeps huge files out of the context window.
plugin/multi-agent-ops.use: You coordinate several agents or start working in an unfamiliar repo.

plugin/python-backend.title: Python backend
plugin/python-backend.summary: A Python backend orchestrator with skills for FastAPI, TDD, Alembic migrations, CI/CD and performance. Runs pytest before it lets the agent stop.
plugin/python-backend.use: You build or maintain a production Python API.

plugin/senior-data-engineer.title: Senior data engineer
plugin/senior-data-engineer.summary: A Google Cloud data engineering agent with BigQuery, Datastream, Dataform and Pub/Sub access, plus gates that block destructive SQL.
plugin/senior-data-engineer.use: You design pipelines, CDC replication or a lakehouse on GCP.

plugin/senior-dev.title: Senior dev
plugin/senior-dev.summary: The core of the kit: an orchestrator that triages each task by risk and delegates to product, design, architecture, implementation, QA and review agents.
plugin/senior-dev.use: You want an agent team that plans first, tests and proves its work.

plugin/senior-dev-flutter.title: Senior dev Flutter
plugin/senior-dev-flutter.summary: A Flutter orchestrator with architecture, implementation, review and release agents. It sequences the official Flutter and Dart skills and runs dart analyze before stopping.
plugin/senior-dev-flutter.use: You build or ship a Flutter app.

plugin/shared-context.title: Shared context
plugin/shared-context.summary: A working memory shared between Claude Code and Antigravity: decisions, conventions and a daily log in a committed context/ folder.
plugin/shared-context.use: You switch between AI tools or sessions and do not want to explain the project again.

plugin/sql-query-optimizer.title: SQL query optimizer
plugin/sql-query-optimizer.summary: Finds slow SQL in .sql files and application code, reads the real execution plan and rewrites the query. Forces a dry run on every BigQuery command.
plugin/sql-query-optimizer.use: A query is slow or expensive in BigQuery, Postgres or MySQL.

skill/adversarial-challenger.title: Adversarial challenger
skill/adversarial-challenger.summary: Stress tests, fuzzing, worst-case inputs, timeouts and concurrency probes that look for the place where the code breaks.
skill/adversarial-challenger.use: The change touches auth, payments, concurrency or untrusted input.

skill/agent-metrics.title: Agent metrics
skill/agent-metrics.summary: Installs, configures and reads agent-meter to answer how much a task, project or client cost and where the time went.
skill/agent-metrics.use: You ask why the agent is slow or expensive.

skill/bigquery-query-optimization.title: BigQuery query optimization
skill/bigquery-query-optimization.summary: Reads the BigQuery query plan (stages, shuffle, workers) and fixes pruning, join order, skew and function choices.
skill/bigquery-query-optimization.use: A BigQuery query is slow, expensive or scans too much.

skill/blackbox-tester.title: Black-box tester
skill/blackbox-tester.summary: Runs real user journeys in a browser with Playwright, checks console and network errors, and saves screenshots at four screen widths.
skill/blackbox-tester.use: A web UI or user flow changed and you need evidence it works.

skill/build-and-ci-gates.title: Build and CI gates
skill/build-and-ci-gates.summary: Sets up linters, formatters, Docker builds and GitHub Actions so broken code never reaches the main branch.
skill/build-and-ci-gates.use: You add CI, linting or build checks to a project.

skill/cdc-scd-patterns.title: CDC and SCD patterns
skill/cdc-scd-patterns.summary: Change data capture with Datastream and slowly changing dimensions (Type 1 and 2) in BigQuery and Dataform.
skill/cdc-scd-patterns.use: You replicate an operational database or keep history in dimension tables.

skill/code-critic.title: Code critic
skill/code-critic.summary: An independent review of complexity, duplication, SOLID, anti-patterns and how easy the code is to change.
skill/code-critic.use: A large diff or a refactor across several modules needs a second opinion.

skill/code-implementer.title: Code implementer
skill/code-implementer.summary: Writes production code with test-driven development: a failing test first, then the smallest clean change that passes.
skill/code-implementer.use: You implement a feature, fix a bug or refactor.

skill/code-smells-expert.title: Code smells expert
skill/code-smells-expert.summary: Finds and classifies code smells and technical debt with the Fowler and Beck catalog, with the reason each one hurts.
skill/code-smells-expert.use: You audit code quality or wonder why something is hard to test.

skill/commit-expert.title: Commit expert
skill/commit-expert.summary: Rules and validator scripts for Conventional Commit messages and local git commit hooks.
skill/commit-expert.use: You write commit messages or set up commit checks.

skill/compliance-verifier.title: Compliance verifier
skill/compliance-verifier.summary: The final check before release: non-functional requirements, static analysis, coverage and security, ending in an approved or rejected verdict.
skill/compliance-verifier.use: A change is finished and needs sign-off.

skill/context-capture.title: Context capture
skill/context-capture.summary: Saves what was done, why and how into context/memory/ so another agent or session can pick up the work.
skill/context-capture.use: You finish a task or want to hand off.

skill/context-restore.title: Context restore
skill/context-restore.summary: Reads the shared memory at the start of a session and summarizes earlier decisions before any work begins.
skill/context-restore.use: You start a session and want to know what was done before.

skill/database-migration-expert.title: Database migration expert
skill/database-migration-expert.summary: Schema migrations, seed scripts and table versioning in Python backends with Alembic and SQL.
skill/database-migration-expert.use: You change a database schema or write a migration.

skill/design-spec-expert.title: Design spec expert
skill/design-spec-expert.summary: Writes a short API or software design spec before coding new endpoints, schemas or services.
skill/design-spec-expert.use: A new endpoint or service needs a contract first.

skill/documentation-expert.title: Documentation expert
skill/documentation-expert.summary: Short, accurate technical documentation: AGENTS.md, DESIGN.md, Diátaxis guides and Mermaid diagrams with checked links.
skill/documentation-expert.use: You write or clean up project documentation.

skill/flutter-architecture-decisions.title: Flutter architecture decisions
skill/flutter-architecture-decisions.summary: Choosing state management (Riverpod, Bloc, signals, setState), package boundaries and layers, recorded as a short ADR.
skill/flutter-architecture-decisions.use: You start a Flutter app or rethink its structure.

skill/flutter-performance-profiling.title: Flutter performance profiling
skill/flutter-performance-profiling.summary: Diagnoses jank, dropped frames and slow startup with DevTools, profile mode and the UI and raster threads, then fixes the cause.
skill/flutter-performance-profiling.use: A Flutter app stutters or feels heavy.

skill/flutter-release-engineering.title: Flutter release engineering
skill/flutter-release-engineering.summary: Flavors, environment config, signing, the build matrix per platform, versioning, store metadata and Shorebird updates.
skill/flutter-release-engineering.use: You set up or review how a Flutter app ships.

skill/flutter-review-checklist.title: Flutter review checklist
skill/flutter-review-checklist.summary: A review of rebuild scope, const, keys, dispose, async BuildContext and design conformance, with a short verdict.
skill/flutter-review-checklist.use: You review a Flutter or Dart pull request.

skill/flutter-senior-orchestration.title: Flutter senior orchestration
skill/flutter-senior-orchestration.summary: Runs a Flutter feature from start to end: restores context, sizes the task, orders the official skills and dispatches the agents.
skill/flutter-senior-orchestration.use: You want a Flutter feature planned, built and verified end to end.

skill/flutter-test-strategy.title: Flutter test strategy
skill/flutter-test-strategy.summary: What to test at unit, widget, golden and integration level, with a test matrix and honest coverage gates.
skill/flutter-test-strategy.use: You plan the tests for a Flutter codebase.

skill/flutter-upgrade-migration.title: Flutter upgrade and migration
skill/flutter-upgrade-migration.summary: Upgrades the Flutter and Dart SDK and major dependencies in order, and clears deprecations across the codebase.
skill/flutter-upgrade-migration.use: You move to a new Flutter version or bump big packages.

skill/gcp-data-engineering.title: GCP data engineering
skill/gcp-data-engineering.summary: Architecture choices for Google Cloud pipelines: lake or warehouse, batch or streaming, Dataform, Composer or Dataflow, and BigQuery cost.
skill/gcp-data-engineering.use: You design a new data pipeline on Google Cloud.

skill/guidelines-karpathy.title: Karpathy guidelines
skill/guidelines-karpathy.summary: Behavior rules that cut common LLM coding mistakes: keep it simple, change only what is needed, state assumptions, define success.
skill/guidelines-karpathy.use: You want an agent that writes less and checks more.

skill/loop-engineering.title: Loop engineering
skill/loop-engineering.summary: The three-tier process: sizes each task, runs only the specialists it needs, isolates parallel workers and caps review loops at three.
skill/loop-engineering.use: You split work across agents or decide how much process a change needs.

skill/performance-scalability.title: Performance and scalability
skill/performance-scalability.summary: Finds and fixes bottlenecks, memory leaks and scaling limits with caching, async workers and load profiling.
skill/performance-scalability.use: Something is slow or will not scale.

skill/product-analyst.title: Product analyst
skill/product-analyst.summary: Turns a vague request into clear scope, user stories and testable acceptance criteria in a 50-line spec.
skill/product-analyst.use: The business rules or scope are unclear.

skill/pull-request-expert.title: Pull request expert
skill/pull-request-expert.summary: Writes short, honest pull requests with commit checks, a link to the test matrix and any skipped gate stated openly.
skill/pull-request-expert.use: You open or review a pull request.

skill/python-expert.title: Python expert
skill/python-expert.summary: Modern Python: PEP 8, type hints and Protocols, generators, slots and dataclasses, asyncio TaskGroup and real error handling.
skill/python-expert.use: You write or review Python code.

skill/qa-tester.title: QA tester
skill/qa-tester.summary: Designs and runs unit, integration and E2E tests and writes a test matrix backed by a real exit code 0.
skill/qa-tester.use: A change needs proof that it works.

skill/refactoring-code-expert.title: Refactoring expert
skill/refactoring-code-expert.summary: Improves structure, readability and extensibility without changing behavior, with design patterns where they help.
skill/refactoring-code-expert.use: You pay down technical debt or fix code smells.

skill/repo-research.title: Repo research
skill/repo-research.summary: Maps a repository's structure, stack, commands and invariants into an 80-line codebase map and a root AGENTS.md.
skill/repo-research.use: You open a codebase you do not know yet.

skill/security-audit.title: Security audit
skill/security-audit.summary: Reviews code, infrastructure as code and designs for injection, broken access control and exposed secrets.
skill/security-audit.use: You need a security review before release.

skill/senior-architect-engineering.title: Senior architecture
skill/senior-architect-engineering.summary: Pragmatic system design with short decision records (ADRs) and an architecture section based on KISS, YAGNI and SOLID.
skill/senior-architect-engineering.use: A change adds a schema, a cross-service contract or a core dependency.

skill/senior-dev-orchestrator.title: Senior dev orchestrator
skill/senior-dev-orchestrator.summary: The playbook the orchestrator follows: restore memory, triage, dispatch agents, verify honestly and save the milestone.
skill/senior-dev-orchestrator.use: You run a feature through the full agent team.

skill/sql-query-optimization.title: SQL query optimization
skill/sql-query-optimization.summary: Reads EXPLAIN plans on Postgres, MySQL or SQL Server and fixes indexes, selectivity, joins, CTEs and pagination.
skill/sql-query-optimization.use: A query is slow on a relational database.

skill/test-driven-development.title: Test-driven development
skill/test-driven-development.summary: Red, green, refactor: failing tests first, solid mocks at the boundaries and designs that are easy to test.
skill/test-driven-development.use: You write new features or add a test suite.

skill/testing-expert.title: Testing expert
skill/testing-expert.summary: Test design across languages: test cases, Arrange-Act-Assert, Gherkin scenarios and honest reporting of what ran.
skill/testing-expert.use: You design tests or a test plan.

skill/ui-ux-designer.title: UI/UX designer
skill/ui-ux-designer.summary: Design systems in a DESIGN.md with tokens, responsive states and WCAG AA accessibility, plus small per-feature design notes.
skill/ui-ux-designer.use: You build new screens or a new visual pattern.

agent/architect-engineer.title: Architect engineer
agent/architect-engineer.summary: Designs module boundaries and API and database contracts, and records each structural decision as a short ADR.
agent/architect-engineer.use: Called when a change introduces a new schema, contract or core dependency.

agent/challenger.title: Challenger
agent/challenger.summary: Attacks the implementation with fuzzing, extreme inputs, failure paths and timeouts to find what breaks.
agent/challenger.use: Called for high-risk logic: auth, payments, concurrency, destructive actions.

agent/code-implementer.title: Code implementer
agent/code-implementer.summary: Writes the production code with TDD inside the files it was assigned, and returns the test command and its exit code.
agent/code-implementer.use: Called in the build phase of every task.

agent/compliance-verifier.title: Compliance verifier
agent/compliance-verifier.summary: Runs static analysis, security checks and architecture rules, and approves or rejects the change.
agent/compliance-verifier.use: Called before any change is reported as done.

agent/context-keeper.title: Context keeper
agent/context-keeper.summary: Maintains the shared memory in context/memory/ and keeps its links in AGENTS.md up to date.
agent/context-keeper.use: Called to save or restore project memory across AI tools.

agent/critic.title: Critic
agent/critic.summary: Reviews the code without changing it: complexity, duplication, SOLID and maintainability.
agent/critic.use: Called for large diffs or refactors across modules.

agent/e2e-blackbox-tester.title: E2E black-box tester
agent/e2e-blackbox-tester.summary: Starts the app, runs the user journeys in a real browser and saves screenshots. Reports blocked when it cannot run, never a fake pass.
agent/e2e-blackbox-tester.use: Called whenever a web UI or user flow changes.

agent/flutter-architect.title: Flutter architect
agent/flutter-architect.summary: Chooses state management, package boundaries and layers for Flutter apps and records the decision as an ADR.
agent/flutter-architect.use: Called when a Flutter feature needs a structural decision.

agent/flutter-feature-orchestrator.title: Flutter feature orchestrator
agent/flutter-feature-orchestrator.summary: Sizes a Flutter request, orders the official Flutter and Dart skills and delegates to the Flutter agents.
agent/flutter-feature-orchestrator.use: Run it as the main session for Flutter work.

agent/flutter-implementer.title: Flutter implementer
agent/flutter-implementer.summary: Builds Flutter and Dart changes with TDD, the official skills and the design tokens from DESIGN.md.
agent/flutter-implementer.use: Called in the build phase of a Flutter task.

agent/flutter-release-engineer.title: Flutter release engineer
agent/flutter-release-engineer.summary: Handles flavors, signing, build matrices, versioning, Shorebird updates and SDK upgrades.
agent/flutter-release-engineer.use: Called when a Flutter app ships or upgrades.

agent/flutter-reviewer.title: Flutter reviewer
agent/flutter-reviewer.summary: Reviews Flutter code for rebuilds, keys, leaks, async context and test coverage, in under 50 lines.
agent/flutter-reviewer.use: Called after a Flutter change is built.

agent/product-analyst.title: Product analyst
agent/product-analyst.summary: Clarifies the business rules and writes the product section of the spec with user stories and acceptance criteria.
agent/product-analyst.use: Called only when scope or acceptance criteria are unclear.

agent/python-backend-orchestrator.title: Python backend orchestrator
agent/python-backend-orchestrator.summary: Plans and governs Python backend work (FastAPI, Django, Flask) with TDD, migrations and security gates.
agent/python-backend-orchestrator.use: Run it as the main session for Python backend work.

agent/qa-tester.title: QA tester
agent/qa-tester.summary: Runs the affected tests and the full suite once per change, extends the test matrix and closes with done or not done.

agent/senior-data-engineer.title: Senior data engineer
agent/senior-data-engineer.summary: Designs and builds data pipelines on Google Cloud: lakehouse, CDC with Datastream, SCD in BigQuery and orchestration.
agent/senior-data-engineer.use: Run it for data pipeline work on GCP.

agent/senior-dev-orchestrator.title: Senior dev orchestrator
agent/senior-dev-orchestrator.summary: Understands the request, asks what is unclear, plans and delegates to the specialists. It never edits application code itself.
agent/senior-dev-orchestrator.use: Run it as the main session for any software task.

agent/sql-query-optimizer.title: SQL query optimizer
agent/sql-query-optimizer.summary: Scans .sql files and SQL inside application code, reads the plan and rewrites the slow queries.
agent/sql-query-optimizer.use: Run it when queries are slow or costly.

agent/ui-ux-designer.title: UI/UX designer
agent/ui-ux-designer.summary: Maintains DESIGN.md and writes the design notes for a feature: layouts, states and accessibility.
agent/ui-ux-designer.use: Called when new screens or visual patterns appear.

hook/agent-meter-hook.title: Agent meter hook
hook/agent-meter-hook.summary: Sends each session and task event to agent-meter so cost and latency are recorded automatically.
hook/agent-meter-hook.use: Runs on session and tool events.

hook/anti-lazy-code-gate.title: Anti-lazy code gate
hook/anti-lazy-code-gate.summary: Looks at the git diff before the agent stops and blocks placeholders such as TODO stubs or omitted code.
hook/anti-lazy-code-gate.use: Runs when the agent tries to stop.

hook/context-guard-gate.title: Context guard
hook/context-guard-gate.summary: Stops the agent from reading very large or binary files in one go, so the context window stays useful.

hook/data-quality-gate.title: Data quality gate
hook/data-quality-gate.summary: Compiles Dataform or dbt before the agent stops and blocks it if the project does not compile.
hook/data-quality-gate.use: Runs when the agent tries to stop.

hook/data-safety-gate.title: Data safety gate
hook/data-safety-gate.summary: Blocks destructive commands such as DROP TABLE, TRUNCATE or DELETE without WHERE.

hook/e2e-evidence-gate.title: E2E evidence gate
hook/e2e-evidence-gate.summary: Rejects a browser test report that has no real screenshots on disk, so no one can claim a test they never ran.
hook/e2e-evidence-gate.use: Runs when a testing subagent finishes.

hook/flutter-pre-tool-gate.title: Flutter plan-first gate
hook/flutter-pre-tool-gate.summary: Requires an up-to-date PLAN.md before any Dart file in lib/ or test/ is written.

hook/flutter-stop-gate.title: Flutter stop gate
hook/flutter-stop-gate.summary: Runs dart analyze when the session ends and blocks stopping while there are errors.
hook/flutter-stop-gate.use: Runs when the agent tries to stop.

hook/git-clean-stop-gate.title: Clean git gate
hook/git-clean-stop-gate.summary: Blocks stopping while merge conflicts or a half-finished merge or rebase remain.
hook/git-clean-stop-gate.use: Runs when the agent tries to stop.

hook/gitflow-branch-gate.title: Gitflow branch gate
hook/gitflow-branch-gate.summary: Denies add, commit, push or merge directly on main or develop, and checks Conventional Commit messages.

hook/orchestrator-role-gate.title: Orchestrator role gate
hook/orchestrator-role-gate.summary: Requires a plan before code changes and stops the orchestrator from editing application code itself.

hook/post-tool-autosave.title: Context autosave
hook/post-tool-autosave.summary: Counts tool calls and time, and reminds the agent to save a memory checkpoint when enough work has piled up.

hook/pre-tool-gate.title: Python plan-first gate
hook/pre-tool-gate.summary: Requires an active PLAN.md before Python files are written.

hook/python-backend-activate.title: Python backend activation
hook/python-backend-activate.summary: Detects a Python backend project and turns on the backend gates for it.
hook/python-backend-activate.use: Runs at the start of a session.

hook/session-start-context.title: Session start context
hook/session-start-context.summary: Tells the agent to read the shared memory at the start of the session.
hook/session-start-context.use: Runs at the start of a session.

hook/sql-safety-gate.title: SQL safety gate
hook/sql-safety-gate.summary: Blocks destructive DDL and DML and forces --dry_run on every bq query.

hook/stop-flush.title: Context flush
hook/stop-flush.summary: Saves a final memory note when a session that did work ends.

hook/stop-gate.title: Python test gate
hook/stop-gate.summary: Runs pytest or unittest before the agent stops and blocks it if tests fail.
hook/stop-gate.use: Runs when the agent tries to stop.

hook/universal-quality-gate.title: Universal quality gate
hook/universal-quality-gate.summary: Detects the stack and runs its tests and checks before the turn ends, for any language.
hook/universal-quality-gate.use: Runs when the agent tries to stop.

rule/clean-code-and-principles.title: Clean code and principles
rule/clean-code-and-principles.summary: SOLID, DRY, KISS and YAGNI as hard rules, plus limits that stop the agent from inventing APIs.
rule/clean-code-and-principles.use: Applies to all code the agent writes.

rule/context-and-token-optimization.title: Context and token use
rule/context-and-token-optimization.summary: Keeps the context window small: read only what is needed and process data with local scripts.

rule/conventional-commits.title: Conventional commits
rule/conventional-commits.summary: Semantic commit messages, atomic commits, branch names and git safety checks.

rule/deployment-restrictions.title: Deployment restrictions
rule/deployment-restrictions.summary: No production build or deploy without explicit approval and passing build checks.
rule/deployment-restrictions.use: Applies whenever something could reach production.

rule/documentation-and-diagrams.title: Documentation and diagrams
rule/documentation-and-diagrams.summary: Standards for comments, docstrings, READMEs, project context and Mermaid diagrams.

rule/loop-engineering-workflow.title: Engineering workflow
rule/loop-engineering-workflow.summary: How much process a change needs: plan, review and QA scaled to the task's risk.
rule/loop-engineering-workflow.use: Applies when planning or splitting work across agents.

rule/pull-requests.title: Pull requests
rule/pull-requests.summary: Size limits, quality gates and a self-review checklist before a pull request is opened.

rule/secure-coding-and-secrets.title: Secure coding and secrets
rule/secure-coding-and-secrets.summary: No hardcoded secrets, validated input and OWASP practices.
rule/secure-coding-and-secrets.use: Applies to all code and config.

rule/skills-and-mcp-awareness.title: Skills and MCP awareness
rule/skills-and-mcp-awareness.summary: How agents find, register and use local skills and MCP servers.
rule/skills-and-mcp-awareness.use: Applies when a task could use a skill or tool.

rule/tdd-best-practices.title: TDD best practices
rule/tdd-best-practices.summary: Red-green-refactor, unit and integration strategy, mock boundaries and how agents prove a change.

rule/testing-after-changes.title: Testing after changes
rule/testing-after-changes.summary: Every generated or changed piece of code gets automated tests and a verification run.

workflow/build-workflow.title: Build incrementally
workflow/build-workflow.summary: Builds the plan in small, tested slices, one vertical step at a time.

workflow/code-simplify-workflow.title: Simplify the code
workflow/code-simplify-workflow.summary: Removes accidental complexity and duplication without changing behavior.
workflow/code-simplify-workflow.use: When working code has become hard to read.

workflow/code-smell-review-workflow.title: Code smell review
workflow/code-smell-review-workflow.summary: Audits code smells and SOLID violations, then refactors them safely.
workflow/code-smell-review-workflow.use: When code quality needs an audit.

workflow/commit-workflow.title: Stage, commit and push
workflow/commit-workflow.summary: Selective staging, a Conventional Commit message and a safe push.
workflow/commit-workflow.use: When work is ready to commit.

workflow/constraints-workflow.title: Set the quality bar
workflow/constraints-workflow.summary: Agrees the limits for the task before work starts: performance, security, style and scope.
workflow/constraints-workflow.use: At the start of a feature.

workflow/feature-development-workflow.title: Feature development cycle
workflow/feature-development-workflow.summary: The full path from request to merged feature: spec, plan, build, test, review and ship.

workflow/grill-me-alignment-workflow.title: Grill me
workflow/grill-me-alignment-workflow.summary: The agent questions you about the design and requirements until nothing important is left open.
workflow/grill-me-alignment-workflow.use: When an idea is still fuzzy.

workflow/perf-workflow.title: Audit performance
workflow/perf-workflow.summary: Measures, finds the bottleneck and fixes it, for backend and web performance.

workflow/plan-workflow.title: Plan how to build it
workflow/plan-workflow.summary: Breaks the spec into tracks, phases and checks in a PLAN.md.

workflow/pull-request-workflow.title: Prepare a pull request
workflow/pull-request-workflow.summary: Self-review, a short description, linked tests and submission.
workflow/pull-request-workflow.use: When a branch is ready for review.

workflow/review-workflow.title: Review before merge
workflow/review-workflow.summary: A structured review of correctness, tests, design and security before merging.

workflow/secure-code-review-workflow.title: Secure code review
workflow/secure-code-review-workflow.summary: A security review of the code and a search for leaked secrets.
workflow/secure-code-review-workflow.use: Before release or after touching sensitive code.

workflow/ship-workflow.title: Ship to production
workflow/ship-workflow.summary: Final checks, release and verification once the change is live.
workflow/ship-workflow.use: When a change is ready to release.

workflow/spec-workflow.title: Define what to build
workflow/spec-workflow.summary: Writes the spec: goal, scope, user stories and acceptance criteria.
workflow/spec-workflow.use: At the start of a feature.

workflow/test-execution-workflow.title: Run tests and coverage
workflow/test-execution-workflow.summary: Runs the test suite and checks coverage with real output.

workflow/test-workflow.title: Prove it works
workflow/test-workflow.summary: Writes and runs the tests that show the change does what it should.

sidecar/incoming-reviews-alert.title: Review request alert
sidecar/incoming-reviews-alert.summary: Every 30 minutes, lists the code reviews and pull requests assigned to you.
sidecar/incoming-reviews-alert.use: You want to know when someone is waiting on your review.

sidecar/pr-reviewer-cron.title: Hourly PR audit
sidecar/pr-reviewer-cron.summary: Every hour, reviews open pull requests for security leaks, leftover TODOs and style problems.
sidecar/pr-reviewer-cron.use: You want open PRs checked without asking.

sidecar/workspace-daemon.title: Workspace daemon
sidecar/workspace-daemon.summary: Watches files in the background and lints and formats them as they change.
sidecar/workspace-daemon.use: You want formatting handled while you work.

tool/agent-meter.title: agent-meter
tool/agent-meter.summary: A standalone CLI and desktop app that shows tokens, cost and time per project, task and subagent for Claude Code and Antigravity, with history, budgets and an optional BigQuery dashboard.
tool/agent-meter.use: You want to see what your AI agents cost and how long they take.

tool/pr-reviewer.title: pr-reviewer
tool/pr-reviewer.summary: An AI reviewer that runs in GitHub Actions and comments on security, performance, design and cost. It never blocks a merge. Works with Gemini, a Claude plan or an API key.
tool/pr-reviewer.use: You want automatic reviews on every pull request.
